name: Phoenix Evans
strengths: Evans mirrors in man with twitchy feet and stays attached through stems at a compact 5-9 / 165.
Evans competes at the catch point and plays with urgency despite lacking ideal length.
Evans shows recovery burst when beaten a step — does not quit on the route.
weaknesses: Evans still needs to prove he can play through bigger SEC outside receivers without losing leverage.
comparison: Evans comps to Asante Samuel Jr. — compact man corner who wins with twitch, competitiveness, and sticky mirror ability.
projection: Evans projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at CB/nickel (special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC nickel / outside CB — the feisty IMG press/man piece who wins with twitch.
schemeFit: Evans fits White’s press/man nickel and outside CB who wins with twitch and competitiveness.
insiderNotes: Evans is a compact IMG Academy corner with twitchy mirror ability, catch-point competitiveness, and recovery burst. Florida is among his top options. Wins with urgency — a nickel/outside CB mold from the IMG circuit.
staffNotes: Vault film desk drafted 2026-08-06 from On3/Hudl + board bio. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Phoenix Evans is a 4 CB · listed 5-9.5 / 165 · IMG Academy (Bradenton, FL) · open-board Florida target.
angle: Lead with IMG man-mirror twitch; Florida among top CB options.
